name: JSL Industries Limited
summary: JSL Industries Limited specializes in the production and distribution of various engineered goods and parts. Their product portfolio encompasses items such as instrument transformers, low-tension switchboards, LT air circuit breakers, air break starters, oil-immersed starters, as well as motors and pumps. Established on June 13, 1966, by Nanubhai B. Amin, the firm's main office is situated in Mogar, India.
